title: Lessons and improvement
description: Turns supported findings into reusable lessons and improvement proposals, then assesses their observed effects.
responsibilities: Characterize reusable lessons with their supporting findings and limits.
Select applicable lessons for planned work and formulate accountable improvements.
Assess observed improvement effects, including recurrence or unresolved effectiveness.

Contribute lesson preparation, context selection, accountable proposals and effect comparison to MOD-017 IF-017 under improvement.md; preserve existing Learning confirmation/custody and separate generic assurance/adoption.
owned_state: Lesson definitions, applicability context, improvement proposals, and effect-assessment context; controlled adoption and evidence judgments remain separately owned.

includes: Reusable learning and preparation and assessment of engineering improvements.
excludes: Treating every local correction as a reusable lesson, automatic adoption, or unsupported effectiveness claims.

design_limits: improvement.md supplies IR-007 AR-082–085 and IF-017 cooperation with existing change-control, assurance and selected retention boundaries.
Participant observations, effectiveness, installed learning guidance and actual adoption/retention require their own evidence; this Design performs none.

sources.basis: Analyst-proposed responsibility boundary derived from the existing Function landscape. Assigned Functions remain authoritative for behavior; this record describes target architecture, not observed implementation.
